vendor_silence.description: the mechanism behind vendor silence when a first-party document does not exist in public. Distinguishes the four mechanisms identified in w10-vendors-who-publish-nothing-export-control-paywall-and-aggregator-only that produce low confidence (0.3-0.5): export-control = legal restriction preventing public datasheet publication (e.g. nv-h20-flopper-specsheet); paywall = commercial silence where document is restricted to members/subscribers (e.g. nrg2-uptime-institute-survey-paywalled); aggregator-only = vendor publishes no specifications or spec table, forcing reliance on secondary aggregators (e.g. cn-cambricon-mlu590, cn-iluvatar-bi-v150); no-config.json = packaging artifact where hosted model repo lacks architecture config (e.g. hf-embed-voyage-code-3). null = not established.
